(V)accination (T)imeliness Percentiles

Source: R/vt_percentile.R
vt_percentile.Rd

This function calculates the number of days since the start of the timeliness window needed to vaccinate a given percentage of the analyzed records, for each dose and geographic area present in data.

Usage

vt_percentile(data, percentiles = c(25, 50, 75))

Arguments

data

The output from the pahoabc::vt_distribution function. The disaggregation is inherited from this data.

percentiles

Numeric. A vector of percentiles (greater than 0 and at most 100) to calculate. Default is c(25, 50, 75).

Value

A data frame with one row per percentile for each dose and geographic area, with the following columns:

  • percentile: the percentile.

  • day: first day since the start of the timeliness window at which the cumulative percentage vaccinated (cdf) reaches the percentile.

  • age: age in days at which the percentile is reached (day + age_schedule_low).

  • within_window: whether day falls within the timeliness window for that dose.

  • window_end: last timely day for that dose.

  • total: number of vaccinations in the EIR for that dose and geographic area, excluding those vaccinated before the timeliness window and those with a missing date.

It can be passed to vt_percentile_plot.
